cohort: The participants were all antenatal admissions and deliveries involving pre-eclampsia at Woldia General Hospital in Ethiopia between 2011 and 2016.
finding: The study found a marginal decrement in pre-eclampsia admission from 2011 to 2016, and that spontaneous onset of labour significantly increased the risk of inpatient eclampsia.
mod_finding: Waiting for spontaneous onset of labour increased the risk of developing inpatient eclampsia.
